content: Task t2 (Bug 2) completed. Fixed 'Add New Symbol' dialog: replaced free-text QLineEdit with a QComboBox dropdown populated from MCP symbols (bridge.fetch_symbols()). Already-registered symbols are filtered out. Shows warning if MCP unavailable. Changed file: paper_trading_v2/gui_tab_onboarding.py (imports + _on_add_symbol method). Ready for t3 assignment.

Bug 1 (Live Control dropdown empty) — completed and fixed.

**Root cause:** The real SystemBridge (`paper_trading_v2/gui_bridge.py`) never loaded validated symbols from YAML config files. MCP-discovered symbols were registered with `status="pending"`, but the Live Control dropdown filter requires `status == "validated"` — so the dropdown was always empty.

**Fix:** Added `_load_symbol_configs()` to `SystemBridge.__init__()` that reads `configs/symbols/XAUUSD.yaml` and `EURUSD.yaml` on startup, registering them with `status="validated"`. The existing MCP refresh guard (`name not in self.state.symbol_registry`) ensures MCP never overwrites validated status.

**Single file changed:** `paper_trading_v2/gui_bridge.py` — added YAML config loader, cleaned up duplicate import.

Integration verification (t4) complete — verdict: PASS ✅

**Bug 1 — Live Control dropdown empty ✅**
gui_bridge.py now has `_load_symbol_configs()` that reads configs/symbols/XAUUSD.yaml and EURUSD.yaml (both with status="validated") at startup, registering them before any GUI tab is constructed. MCP poll uses `name not in self.state.symbol_registry` guard so validated status is never overwritten by MCP "pending" registration.

**Bug 2 — Free-text input → dropdown ✅**
gui_tab_onboarding.py `_on_add_symbol()` now shows a QDialog with non-editable QComboBox populated from bridge.fetch_symbols(), filtered against already-registered symbols. Shows appropriate QMessageBox when MCP disconnected or all symbols already registered.

**Bug 3 — Second symbol hides first row ✅**
gui_tab_onboarding.py `_refresh_symbols()` now calls `self._table.resizeRowsToContents()` after rebuilding. Also fixed the `setForeground(str)` TypeError by wrapping with `QColor()`. Both rows remain fully visible.

**Files changed:** gui_bridge.py, gui_tab_onboarding.py
**No breakage:** All other files unchanged. Python syntax validated. No circular imports introduced.
**Minor note:** Orphaned QWidget instances from `setCellWidget()` are not explicitly cleaned up (minor memory leak) — doesn't affect visual behavior.
